messages.subject: Differences in dung decay rates
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to analyse a data set of dung counts of Red deer.

I collected data by stratified sampling. Study areas were initially =
stratified into different blocks according to the level of human activity =
(low/high) and then by habitat type (three habitat types with contrasting =
ground covers).=20

I also estimated the dung decay rates of Red deer. My dung decay rates =
vary by habitat type and also by season.

My questions are....

1) As I have to analyse the data in separate files for separate habitats =
for a given season (due to differences in decay rates) how can I compare =
the densities between habitats?

2) Is there any way that I could check the impact of ground cover on pdf =
when I analyse data for in different files for different habitats ? I've =
got data on height of ground cover for different habitats and seasons.

Any comments/ suggestions much appreciated.
